title: Street poster series

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study

slide_intent: Vary the story while maintaining shared structure because viewers should recognize a campaign across repeated encounters.
strategic_value: Alternating illustrated stories and a text-only statement can give Figma’s public campaign variety without losing its central teamwork argument.
demonstration: A wall carries orange, lavender, white and partly visible green posters with large headlines, contributor illustrations and small Figma marks.
practical_value: Balance illustrated examples with a concise typographic poster within one campaign run.

content_islands.name: Illustrated posters
content_islands.spec: Place architecture and Frankenstein stories at left, with the partially visible relativity treatment at right.

content_islands.name: Typographic pause
content_islands.spec: Place the white GENIUS / US statement between the illustrated posters.

content_islands.name: Street context
content_islands.spec: Retain wall, pavement and curled poster corner to show scale and placement.

reference_purposes.Application: The photograph demonstrates the campaign as a repeated street-poster installation.
reference_purposes.Intent: Printed captions connect the illustrated subjects to contributions from multiple people.
